'''Skills''' are unique features that grant [[Raider]]s passive improvements or new abilities. They are purchased at the Skill Tree using a special [[Currency|currency]] called {{Price||Skill Points}} [[Skill Points]].

== Obtaining ==
Raiders are rewarded one Skill Point each time they gain enough [[Experience|experience]] to level up, for a total of 76. Additionally, up to five Skill Points can be earned for each completed [[Expedition]].

== Skill Tree ==
The Skill Tree is split into three "branches" that focus on different specializations: '''Conditioning''', '''Mobility''', and '''Survival'''. There is no restriction on spending Skill Points between branches, but many Skills only become available after a prerequisite number of Skill Points are spent in a specific branch.

Sometimes mistakes are made, or it is time to change things up. Raiders can spend {{Price|2,000}} Coins per {{Price||Skill Points}} Skill Point to reset their entire Skill Tree. Currently, there is no option to reset individual branches or Skills.

| ! style="text-align:center; | [[File:Icon Skill Small Node.png|45px]]
| Small Node
| The small nodes provide a range of skills that allow the player to choose the skills they want their raider to have. The small nodes also allow you to progress deeper into the Skill Tree. To reach the next node along a path, you must have at least one skill point in the node prior to it. small nodes can vary in the number of points that can be allocated
* Some skills require only 1 skill point in order to acquire the full benefit of that skill. (Goes solid green) 
* Others require anywhere from 1 to 5 skill points to max. (Have a green outline if not maxed)
|-
| ! style="text-align:center; | [[File:Icon Skill Large Node.png|75px]]
| Large Node
| Large Nodes are the diamond-shaped nodes in the skill tree. These nodes, unlike the small nodes, provide the player with a choice between several options. To unlock the large node, you must have at least one of the small nodes prior to it unlocked, and the adequate skill points allocated to that branch: 10, 30, 40, respectively.
|}

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:left; vertical-align: center"
|-
| ! style="text-align:center; | [[File:Icon Large Node Unlock Levels.png|250px]]
| 
* '''1st Large node''' provides 2 options to choose from, only one of these skills
** 10 Skill points are required to unlock the options
* '''2nd Large node''' provides 3 options to choose from, a maximum of 2/3 options can be selected.
** 30 skill points are required to unlock your first choice
** 40 Skill points are required to unlock your second choice
|}
